chunk_findings.detail: `_manifest` reads `led["done"]["files"]` from the ledger dictionary without checking whether the key `"done"` or `"files"` exists. If an item in the ledger lacks a `"done"` dictionary or has an incomplete entry (which commonly occurs for tasks that are not yet marked done, or when inspecting states where completion metadata is absent), `_manifest` raises a `KeyError`, causing `verify()` to crash with an unhandled exception for valid repository states.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/verify.py:_manifest

chunk_findings.detail: `_manifest` treats any dirty `UM.lint()` result as this landing's fault. It only checks that some done-file path is a declaration (`ddflow/config_sections/`, handlers, `model.py`, `config.py`), then fails on every id in `res.unmanifested`. Given a tree that already has an unannounced knob `locks.old`, a completion whose only change is a comment in `ddflow/config_sections/locks.py` (no new knob, no fragment owed) still gets `manifest=fail` naming `locks.old`. The inverse also slips through: a knob added in a file outside `_DECL_PREFIXES`/`_DECL_FILES` never raises the claim, and a completion with `files_known` false returns `None` and merges silently — the bug this guard is supposed to stop.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/verify.py:_manifest

chunk_findings.detail: The suite never asserts the success path the claim documents. `test_a_landing_that_adds_an_unannounced_knob_fails` forces a fail via monkeypatch, and the other test only checks that a non-declaration edit omits the claim. An implementation that always returns `FAIL` whenever a declaration path is in `done.files` — even when `UM.lint()` is clean and a `knob_added.*.toml` fragment is present — still passes both tests, so the promise that a matching announcement lets the landing complete is unenforced.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_verify_manifest.py:test_a_landing_that_adds_an_unannounced_knob_fails

chunk_findings.detail: `_manifest` reads `led["done"]["files"]` from the ledger dictionary without checking whether the key `"done"` or `"files"` exists.
